summary: Iteration 22: verified new driver quotation flow — bid cap (max 2), withdraw & re-quote lifecycle. Backend pytest (2/2) plus a full Playwright e2e on mobile viewport all pass. Bidding job detail shows Submit+Message only (no Decline). Waiting job detail shows Withdraw+Message. Withdrawal returns the job to the open Quotation list with '1 quote left' shown. Second withdraw exhausts the job and removes it from /driver/available. Third bid attempt is blocked with 400 'maximum of 2 quotes'.
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint naming inconsistency: review request mentions POST /api/bookings/{id}/broadcast-bidding but the actual route is POST /api/bookings/{id}/broadcast. Consider aligning docs/spec or adding an alias — noted for main agent.
server.py is ~1792 lines; consider modularising (driver routes, booking routes, chat routes) for maintainability.
